taglines: Feeding epic days and wilder lives
origin: Park City UT, Wasatch Mountains — 1982 Joel Clark red wagon heirloom whole wheat flapjack recipe; 1995 incorporation; 2014 Shark Tank; Vital Ground Foundation grizzly habitat partner; Zac Efron Chief Brand Officer since 2022; Keep It Wild trademark 98397901

photography_direction.wasatch_mountains: Snow-dusted Wasatch Range at dawn / alpenglow, pine/boulder foreground, wide authentic alpine — not oversaturated stock Rockies. Use as blurred cover background with sky negative space for text overlay. Palette: cool rock + warm sunrise vs #3B2316/#E8530E/#1A3C34 accent.
photography_direction.rugged_pioneers: Modern pioneers, not costume — denim/flannel/beanies/canvas tote with red-wagon callback. Diverse cast 25-45 + cubs. Actions: flipping flapjacks on cast iron over campfire, trailhead prep, ski-cabin porch. Grit + warmth, honest hands, movement blur; not luxury wellness.
photography_direction.grizzly_keep_it_wild: Wild grizzly at safe distance in meadow/river or subtle cues (tracks, silhouette, steam bear shape). No captive bear close-up (avoid PETA 2022 controversy). Habitat connectivity: Six Lower-48 recovery zones, One Landscape Initiative. Vital Ground co-badge small.
photography_direction.high_protein_active_families: Post-hike kitchen table: steam, stack of Buttermilk Power Cakes (14g protein per serving), Bear Bites graham for cubs, maple oatmeal cup on trail. Natural light, wood table, enamel mug, protein cues visible. Fuel, not indulgence.
photography_direction.product_hero: Premium studio hero — centered product on clean light background, soft shadow, 1024x1024, photorealistic, no text/no logo (logo overlaid in compose.py). DAM reuse for power-cakes/hero.png; Nova Canvas for bear-bites/oatmeal-cup.

voice_tone.adventurous: Verbs-forward, trail-ready invites: 'Fuel your frontier', 'Blaze your morning trail', 'Epic days start here'. Second-person, active, outdoor imperatives. Keep It Wild as call to explore.
voice_tone.nourishing: Whole-grain honesty + protein purpose (14g). 'Heirloom recipe, 100% whole grains' — warm parental, never diet jargon. Real food tradition.
voice_tone.rugged: Wasatch-born grit, honest, unpolished but not gruff. Short sentences, light frontier idioms ('keep it wild', 'wilder lives') without cowboy cosplay. #3B2316 brown/ #1A3C34 green anchors trust; #E8530E pop for energy.
voice_tone.guardrails: Use approved claim 'Protein-packed whole grains for today's frontier.' Avoid unsubstantiated % claims (17% class action precedent). Legal/compliance via compliance.py: logo_overlay true, palette probe, prohibited_terms.
voice_tone.localization: US-MW: mountain/snow/trailing haze Wasatch; US-SE: family breakfast, Publix porch, humidity-green, home-anchored. Both rugged but distinct — see briefs/kodiak.yaml vs kodiak-se.yaml.
